extDescription.message: One key (F18 by default) jumps a paused YouTube live stream back to live, and plays or pauses everything else.

behaviorLivePaused.message: Live stream, paused: presses the “Live” button and resumes from the latest point

recordingHint.message: Press the key you want to use (Esc to cancel)

showToastLabel.message: Show a notice on screen when the key is pressed

statusPrintableNote.message: (won't trigger while typing in chat or other text fields)

troubleFunctionKeys.message: F13–F24 aren't on regular keyboards. Send them from a Stream Deck, AutoHotkey, or your keyboard's macro feature.

troubleFocus.message: Keys only arrive while a YouTube tab is showing in Chrome and the page has focus.

troubleReload.message: Reload any YouTube tabs that were open before you installed the extension.

troubleAds.message: During ads, the “Live” button isn't pressed; the key only toggles play / pause.
